game_overview: Lead Tuareg camel caravans across the Sahara. Each turn you add camels to your caravans to reach water holes, link to oases and wall off land. The game ends the moment any one camel color runs out.
objective: Score the most points from water hole tokens, oases, enclosed areas and the largest caravan of each color.

components_overview.name: Game Board
components_overview.description: Double-sided hex board: mountain side (standard) and river side (variant).

components_overview.name: Pastel Camels
components_overview.description: 5 colors (green, pink, yellow, purple, turquoise), 35 of each. The shared camel supply.

components_overview.name: Gray Camels
components_overview.description: Carry each player's gray leader, a reminder of who plays which color.

components_overview.name: Riders
components_overview.description: 5 player colors, 6 of each. A rider on a camel is a leader: it starts one of your caravans.

components_overview.name: 5-Point Tokens
components_overview.description: Taken when a caravan links to an oasis.

components_overview.name: Caravan Tokens
components_overview.description: 10 points each, one per camel color, for the largest caravan of that color.

setup.description: Place the game board mountain side up (the river side is a variant).
Spaces beyond the elevation line are not used.
Each player takes the 6 leaders of their color and places the gray leader in front of them as a color reminder.
Each player returns one leader to the box. All returned leaders must ride different pastel camel colors. Each player controls 4 caravans.
Sort the camels without riders by color into a shared supply.
Return 4 camels of each color to the box.
Return 8 camels of each color to the box.
Place the 5 palm trees, one per space, on large pools of water. These spaces are the oases.
Shuffle the waterhole tokens and place one face up on every small pool and on every large pool without a palm tree.
Put the point tokens near the board, sorted by type.

Starting with the first player and going clockwise, place leaders (not gray) one at a time on empty spaces: NOT on a waterhole, an oasis, a mountain or another leader, and NOT next to an oasis or ANY leader.
The first leader each player places must ride a camel color that no leader already on the board has.

turn_steps: Take two camels from the supply, in any colors.
Place them to extend your caravans of those colors.
Score whatever the new camels reach, immediately.

actions.name: 1. Place Camels
actions.description: Add two camels to your caravans.

steps.description: Take two camels from the supply: two of one color or two different colors.
Place each camel next to your caravan of the same color.

not_touch.label: a rival's caravan of that color

notes.description: First turn: the first two players place only one camel each.
First turn: the first player places only one camel.
NOT on a mountain, an occupied space or an oasis.
Caravans may fork; they do not have to form a single line.
A camel may be placed next to a camel of a different color, whoever owns it.
NEVER next to another player's camel of the same color: two caravans of one color cannot merge.
No camel may be placed inside an enclosed area.

actions.name: 2. Score as You Go
actions.description: Points are taken the moment a camel lands.

steps.description: Waterhole: place a camel on a space with a waterhole token and take the token face down. Keep it hidden until the end.
Oasis: when a caravan is placed next to an oasis, it links to that oasis. Take a 5-point token.

Enclose: when a single caravan, with the board edge or a mountain, completely surrounds an area that holds no other camels, take every waterhole token inside and a 5-point token for each oasis inside that this caravan is not linked to yet.

notes.description: Each caravan links to each oasis only once. One caravan can link to many oases.
Any number of caravans, from any players, can link to the same oasis.
You cannot enclose an area with caravans of different colors.
Enclosed areas score 1 point per empty space at the end of the game, not counting oases.

end_game.trigger: The game ends at the end of the turn in which the last camel of any one color is placed.

procedure.description: For each camel color, the player with the most camels in a caravan of that color takes that color's 10-point caravan token.
If players tie for the largest caravan of a color, each tied player takes a 5-point token and nobody takes the caravan token.

final_scoring.description: Waterhole, oasis, caravan and spare point tokens taken during the game.
1 point per empty space inside each of your enclosed areas, not counting oases.

winning_condition: The player with the most points wins. Tied players share the victory.

tips_for_new_players.description: The board edge and mountains help you enclose large areas with few camels.
The game ends the moment any one color runs out. Count the colors that are running low.
Your caravan blocks rivals' caravans of the same color, so a well-placed camel can cut a rival off from an oasis.
